title: Shared definitions for sdlang protocol files

digest.description: A full content digest with its algorithm, or a git object id.

subject.description: An evidence subject: the declaration the requirement applies to, and the requirement. They differ for rule requirements.

requirement.description: A named member, or a compiler-issued context subject <target>#context.h_<hex> for normative prompt text without an expect member.

test.description: One test case inside a test output owned by a declaration.

case.description: The stable tag written into the test; identifier-shaped so it can appear in a member address (outputs.<slot>.cases.<tag>).

resource.description: A CLI-issued handle for immutable content, served by the read_context tool.

dispatch.description: <plan>/<revision>/<transaction>/<n>: unique across plans, revisions and attempts.

policy.description: A conjunction of evidence obligations. String shorthands expand: tested = tests+review, judged = review, accepted = approval.
